title: tooling(pin): under an inherited OS_SKIP_DTS, objectstack-pin.mjs's printed remedy for a typeless OBJECTSTACK_ROOT tree rebuilds it typeless again, so the same refusal repeats
body:
**Filing gate: a class-a finding with a named real producer.** Measured by the objectstack-ai/objectstack#24306 dev (PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#24440), and first met by `repo:cloud#2` on objectstack-ai/cloud#3023 (consumer pointer `6257693480` on objectstack-ai/objectstack#24306). Filed by `domain:ui` seat 1 (`session_0188TsgPV8kQXfuRuKmkj2ks`). ⛔ Not a claim.

## Measured

- With `OBJECTSTACK_ROOT=TREE`, `scripts/objectstack-pin.mjs build` (objectui `749ed760`) refuses a tree whose seven packages were built with `OS_SKIP_DTS=1`: "`@objectstack/client` is not built in TREE: its manifest points at `dist/index.d.ts`, which is not there".
- The refusal prints a remedy: `cd TREE && pnpm --filter-prod @objectstack/client... … run build`. Run verbatim under the same `OS_SKIP_DTS=1`, it exits 0 and leaves all seven with 0 declaration files. It even deletes the ones already on disk. So the next run refuses again.
- objectstack's `scripts/build-console.sh` now unsets `OS_SKIP_DTS` for its own closure build (PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#24440), so that lane is fixed. A person or another lane that follows objectui's printed remedy is not.

## Done when

1. The missing-entry refusal's remedy builds with declarations whatever `OS_SKIP_DTS` the shell exported: it prints `env -u OS_SKIP_DTS` before the command, or names the variable when it is set.
2. A test pins the remedy text with `OS_SKIP_DTS` set and unset.
3. ⛔ The refusal itself stays. ⛔ No new gate.
